title: Polar characterization of Gaussian disagreement
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and let $p=(r,\theta)$ lie in the target of the polar-coordinate map. The point obtained by applying the inverse polar-coordinate map to $p$ belongs to the Gaussian source disagreement set at correlation $\rho$ if and only if $\theta\in(-\pi,\pi)$ and $\cos\theta\,\cos(\theta-\arccos\rho)<0$.
